definitions.returnMap:
/-- The return map of a loop of links: the difference that comes back after one turn for the
difference sent, the first link applied first. -/
def returnMap : List (Nat → Nat) → Nat → Nat
  | [], x => x
  | g :: gs, x => returnMap gs (g x)

definitions.Every:
/-- The law of every step, read on a pattern: the relata taking from the family are at least
one where anything is taken from it and at most what is taken; something exchanges where
anything is taken from or given to it. -/
def Every (P : List Passage) (k : Nat) (e : Prop) : Prop :=
  sign (total P Passage.taken) ≤ k ∧ k ≤ total P Passage.taken ∧
    (0 < total P Passage.taken ∨ 0 < total P Passage.given → e)
definitions.Passage:
/-- What one step shows of one condition: its level before and after the step, and what the
relata taking part take from it and give to it across the step. -/
structure Passage where
  before : Nat
  after : Nat
  taken : Nat
  given : Nat
definitions.Realized:
/-- Some world shows the pattern across some step on some family where the condition holds,
listing each relatum taking part once. -/
def Realized (cond : (w : World) → Nat → List w.Relatum → Prop) (P : List Passage) (k : Nat)
    (e : Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ (w : World) (t : Nat) (es : List w.Relatum), cond w t es ∧ Distinct (w.flow.present t) ∧
    w.flow.Realizes w.web t es P k e

definitions.ReadsSetsOn:
/-- A ranking of presentations reads the sets on the pair `a`, `b`: it ranks them, each way, as
the order `O` ranks the courses they keep. A presentation is a plan with its wording and the
order in which it is told; `kept` gives the course it keeps; `R b a` reads "`a` is ranked above
`b`". -/
def ReadsSetsOn (kept : P → X → Bool) (R : P → P → Prop) (O : (X → Bool) → (X → Bool) → Prop)
    (a b : P) : Prop :=
  (R b a ↔ O (kept b) (kept a)) ∧ (R a b ↔ O (kept a) (kept b))
definitions.WidensBy:
/-- On the listed items `a` widens `b` by `x` alone: it admits every item `b` admits and `x`,
which is listed and which `b` does not admit, and nothing else beyond `b`. -/
def WidensBy (items : List X) (x : X) (a b : X → Bool) : Prop :=
  IncludesOn items a b ∧ x ∈ items ∧ a x = true ∧ b x = false ∧
    ∀ y, y ∈ items → a y = true → b y = false → y = x
definitions.ranksNet:
/-- The order of a net weighting: each listed item counts `pos` for a course that admits it and
`neg` against it, so it weighs above zero where `neg x < pos x`, at zero where they are equal and
below zero where `pos x < neg x`. `a` is ranked above `b` where what `a` gains less what it loses
exceeds `b`'s, compared without subtraction. A weighting is the net weighting with nothing
against. -/
def ranksNet (items : List X) (pos neg : X → Nat) : (X → Bool) → (X → Bool) → Prop :=
  fun b a => weighed items pos b + weighed items neg a < weighed items pos a + weighed items neg b

definitions.NaturalLabelling:
/-- A **natural labelling** of `c`: a renumbering of its elements keeping precedence, the order of
births of a course growing a configuration of its kind (`natural_iff_course`). -/
def NaturalLabelling (c : Causet) (π σ : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  Reindexes 0 c.size π σ ∧ KeepsOrder c.prec 0 c.size π
definitions.Causet:
/-- A labelled finite causal set: `size` elements, `0` to `size - 1`, and their precedence. -/
structure Causet where
  size : Nat
  prec : Nat → Nat → Prop
definitions.Ordered:
/-- A causal set of the growth: precedence transitive, each element preceded only by smaller labels,
and on the elements. -/
structure Causet.Ordered (c : Causet) : Prop where
  trans : ∀ {i j k}, c.prec i j → c.prec j k → c.prec i k
  labelled : ∀ {i j}, c.prec i j → i < j
  within : ∀ {i j}, c.prec i j → j < c.size
definitions.Relabels:
/-- A relabelling carrying `c` onto `c'`: `σ` and `τ` inverse between their elements, with the
precedence read through `σ`. -/
def Relabels (c c' : Causet) (σ τ : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, i < c.size → σ i < c'.size ∧ τ (σ i) = i) ∧
    (∀ j, j < c'.size → τ j < c.size ∧ σ (τ j) = j) ∧
    ∀ i j, i < c.size → j < c.size → (c.prec i j ↔ c'.prec (σ i) (σ j))

definitions.holdFrom:
/-- The course `o` before `t`, and `x` from `t` on. -/
def holdFrom (o : Nat → O) (t : Nat) (x : O) (n : Nat) : O := if n < t then o n else x
definitions.prefixOf:
/-- The prefix of a course before step `t`, latest first. -/
def prefixOf (o : Nat → O) : Nat → List O
  | 0 => []
  | t + 1 => o t :: prefixOf o t

definitions.ReachesBefore:
/-- The part reaches `g` before `t`: at a step before `t` a member exchanged with a condition `g`
requires at `t`. -/
def ReachesBefore (part : F → Bool) (t : Nat) (g : F) : Prop :=
  ∃ h c s, part h = true ∧ W.requires t g c ∧ s < t ∧ h ∈ L.present s ∧
    (0 < L.take s h c ∨ 0 < L.give s h c)

definitions.kids:
def kids : Nat → Relatum → List Relatum
  | 0 => kids₀
  | 1 => kids₁
  | _ + 2 => fun _ => []
definitions.need:
/-- The body's parts need two of the body; the spreading lineage's descendants need one of the
condition outside it; nothing else is needed. -/
def need (f c : Relatum) : Nat := ofBody f * 2 * atBody c + beyond f * atOutside c
definitions.present:
/-- The cell and both founders take part across the first step, each founder taking one unit of
the body; the spreading lineage's descendant alone across the second; then nothing. -/
def present : Nat → List Relatum
  | 0 => [cell, confined, spread]
  | 1 => [spread₁]
  | _ + 2 => []
definitions.family:
/-- The pool and the two offspring. -/
def family : List Relatum := [pool, left, right]
definitions.give:
def give : Nat → Relatum → Relatum → Nat
  | 0 => giveFirst
  | _ + 1 => fun _ _ => 0
